title: Håstad test acceptance for a dictator
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $\delta\in[0,1]$, and let $i$ be a coordinate in $\mathrm{Fin}\,n$. The Håstad test with noise parameter $\delta$ accepts the Boolean dictator on coordinate $i$, viewed as a function with values in $[-1,1]$, with probability $1-\delta/2$.
